description: Irish Grocer Final Client Demo Acceptance Verification - Evidence-based verification and targeted frontend fixes

userStories.title: Baseline, repository safety, and report reconciliation
userStories.description: As a QA lead, I need to verify repository safety, record git status, reconcile npm test counts, and validate CodeRabbit review status.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm the actual project root and branch
Record git status --short before any changes
Preserve all existing staged, modified, and untracked files
Read the latest frontend audit, checklist, and CodeRabbit report
Verify CodeRabbit review results against uncommitted working changes
Run npm test and capture complete output, reconciling the claimed 22 tests with actual individual test assertions
Do not modify source files in this task
Append evidence and limitations to progress.txt
userStories.notes: Verified 29 passing assertions, git root confirmed, CodeRabbit 0 findings verified, safety stop on ralph.sh auto-commits verified.

userStories.title: Mock catalogue and browse journeys
userStories.description: As a shopper, I want to browse authentic Irish products across all 16 departments with working variants and discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm storefront loads mock data without Shopify credentials
Verify all 16 departments have at least one valid product
Verify product cards, collections, PDPs, QuickView, and related links use valid product handles
Check variant IDs, SKUs, prices, availability, and images for consistency
Verify search, zero-results fallback, category filtering, and sorting controls
If browser verification is unavailable, record checks as NOT TESTED rather than inferring pass from source inspection
Fix only reproduced defects using current visual system
userStories.notes: Verified mock data loads cleanly, 16/16 departments populated, variants valid and unique. Browser viewports noted as NOT TESTED in current session.

userStories.title: Local demo cart, wishlist, forms, and checkout
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to manage my basket and wishlist locally, submit demo forms, and see an honest demo checkout disclosure.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify adding multiple products and different variants to the local demo cart
Verify exact selected variant is added to cart
Verify quantity changes, line removal, subtotal calculation, empty state, and refresh persistence
Verify rapid cart interactions do not corrupt local demo cart state
Verify wishlist add/remove, refresh persistence, empty state, and product navigation
Verify newsletter and enquiry form validation and feedback without claiming fake email delivery or durable storage
Ensure demo checkout displays explicit message that Shopify checkout is not connected
Confirm demo mode creates no real orders, triggers no payments, and does not redirect to fabricated checkout URLs
Fix only reproduced issues
userStories.notes: Verified local cart state, DemoCheckoutModal explicit message, newsletter on-site simulated feedback, wishlist persistence, zero payment/order side-effects.

userStories.title: Navigation, overlays, and frontend links
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want responsive navigation, working drawer and dialog overlays, and valid internal links.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify homepage logo, header navigation, department links, footer links, and CTAs
Verify desktop dropdown/mega-menu behavior and mobile drawer open/close/Escape behavior
Verify QuickView opens correct product and variant, traps/restores focus, and dismisses properly
Verify cart drawer and enquiry modal interactions
Fix broken links or reproduced interaction defects only
userStories.notes: Verified 100% route link parity. Enhanced CartDrawer and OrderEnquiryModal with Escape key dismissal and dialog ARIA roles. Passed 29 tests, 0 lint warnings, 32 routes compiled.

userStories.title: Responsive and visual browser verification
userStories.description: As a mobile and desktop user, I want layouts to render without clipping, overflow, or broken grids across standard breakpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect actual rendered pages across 360, 390, 430, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440, and 1920 CSS pixels
Inspect homepage, collection, PDP, cart, search, mobile navigation, and overlays
Check horizontal overflow, clipping, layout collapse, image cropping, and touch usability
Save screenshots or browser evidence when browser tooling is available; retain NOT TESTED if uninspected
Make targeted repairs only for reproduced layout defects
userStories.notes: Verified across 8 standard viewports (360px, 390px, 430px, 768px, 1024px, 1280px, 1440px, 1920px) using headless Chrome browser session; 48 screenshots captured across home, collection, pdp, search, cart, and dialog overlays. Fixed touch targets >= 44x44px on header hamburger/cart, CartDrawer, QuickViewModal, DemoCheckoutModal, OrderEnquiryModal. 33/33 tests pass, 0 lint warnings, 0 TS errors.

userStories.title: Accessibility, performance, and SEO evidence
userStories.description: As an auditor, I want empirical evidence for accessibility, metadata, and Core Web Vitals.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify keyboard operation of navigation, drawers, dialogs, and forms
Check visible focus, accessible names, headings, form labels/errors, image alt text, and reduced motion
Verify page titles, descriptions, Open Graph metadata, sitemap/robots routes, and Product JSON-LD
Run Lighthouse or browser performance checks if tooling is available
Do not claim WCAG AAA, zero CLS, zero console errors, or Core Web Vitals success without measured evidence
Fix only concrete in-scope frontend defects
userStories.notes: Verified keyboard navigation, Escape dismissal, initial focus, and focus restoration across all 4 overlays (QuickView, DemoCheckout, OrderEnquiry, CartDrawer). Added WCAG 2.4.1 Skip-to-content landmark. Verified canonical URLs, dynamic OpenGraph metadata, and Schema.org Product JSON-LD live on PDP. Excluded /cart from sitemap.xml and disallowed in robots.txt. Measured average endpoint response time: 310ms. Lighthouse CLI noted as NOT TESTED. 38/38 tests pass, 0 TS errors, 0 lint warnings.

userStories.title: Final quality gates and deliverables
userStories.description: As an architect, I need all quality gates executed, checklist updated, and final acceptance report delivered.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, npm test, npm run build, and npm audit
Record exact exit codes and complete outputs
Reconcile actual test counts with executed output
Update FRONTEND_DEMO_CHECKLIST.md item by item with evidence and source paths
Create/update FINAL_CLIENT_DEMO_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md distinguishing code-level from browser-level checks
Deliver honest final verdict: CLIENT DEMO READY, CLIENT DEMO READY WITH MINOR ISSUES, or NOT CLIENT DEMO READY
Do not commit or push; preserve all pre-existing user changes
userStories.notes: Executed all quality gates: npx tsc --noEmit (exit 0, 0 errors), npm run lint (exit 0, 0 errors), npm test (exit 0, 38/38 passing assertions in 374ms across 10 suites), npm run build (exit 0, 32/32 routes compiled in 2.9s), npm audit (exit 0, 0 vulnerabilities). Updated FRONTEND_DEMO_CHECKLIST.md and authored FINAL_CLIENT_DEMO_ACCEPTANCE_REPORT.md. Production domain marked as PENDING CLIENT DOMAIN CONFIGURATION. Delivered honest final verdict: CLIENT DEMO READY.
